rasterPolicy: Optional CPU mode omits paints only into the main output canvas and temporary-body output canvases after their real alpha bounds/readiness are measured. Transforms, metrics, decoding, source masks, scratch canvases, readbacks and all geometry/anchor updates remain active. Paired mode compares identical seeded command, result and combat-event streams.
renderPolicy: First scene rendered at the declared page DPR (0.5 normally; 1 for the bounded counter capture); subsequent bone soak skips unobserved GPU submissions and render-target readbacks. No performance claim.
overlapPolicy: Reference 80% footprint radii, actual ankle-mesh footprint hulls with the same margin, and actual cover bounds with the reference half-radius margin.

dead actor retains an active attack

weaponCoverage.policy: Campaign rotates all 24 Workshop weapons with floor(index/8) phase; fixed Citadel retains factory missile. Index22 preserves original regression weapons. Actual all-weapon landed-contact coverage, built-ins and shoulder launcher are asserted separately by scene-combat.cjs.
